data.name: Furqaniyah
data.gender_notes: Furqaniyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: One who distinguishes right from wrong
data.long_meaning: Furqaniyah is derived from the Arabic word 'Furqan' which means to differentiate or distinguish. This name signifies one who has the ability to discern right from wrong and is capable of making wise decisions. The name Furqaniyah carries the meaning “One who distinguishes right from wrong” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Furqaniyah usually hope their child will grow to embody one who distinguishes right from wrong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies wisdom, discernment, and righteousness.
data.etymology: Furqaniyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who distinguishes right from wrong.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Furqaniyah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: فرقانية
in_arabic.meaning: الفرقان هي كتاب الله الذي يفرق بين الحق والباطل
in_arabic.long_meaning: الفرقانية هي اسم مشتق من الفرقان، وهو مصطلح قرآني يشير إلى القرآن الكريم الذي يعتبره المسلمون كتاب الله المعجز الذي أنزل على النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم. الفرقان يعني التمييز بين الحق والباطل، والهداية للطريق المستقيم. يعتبر اسم الفرقانية رمزًا للهداية والتمييز بين الخير والشر.

in_urdu.name: فرقانیہ
in_urdu.meaning: فرقانیہ کا مطلب ہے وہ کتاب جو حق و باطل میں فرق کرتی ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: فرقانیہ نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ 'فرقان' سے ماخوذ ہے، جو قرآن کریم کا ایک اور نام ہے۔ قرآن کریم کو فرقان اس لیے کہا جاتا ہے کیونکہ وہ حق و باطل کے درمیان فرق کرنے والا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ یہ قرآن کی یاد دلاتا ہے جو مسلمانوں کے لئے ایک روحانی رہنما ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फ़ुरकानिया
in_hindi.meaning: फ़ुरकानिया का अर्थ है सच्चाई और झूठ के बीच अंतर करने वाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़ुरकानिया नाम अरबी भाषा के शब्द 'फ़ुरकान' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है वह चीज़ जो सच्चाई और झूठ के बीच अंतर करती है। इस नाम का संबंध कुरआन से है, जिसे मुसलमान लोग अपनी पवित्र पुस्तक मानते हैं। यह नाम हिदायत और सच्चाई की पहचान करने की क्षमता का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: فرقانيه
in_pashto.meaning: فرقانيه د حق او باطل تر منځ د توپير کتاب
in_pashto.long_meaning: فرقانيه نوم د 'فرقان' څخه اخستل شوی دی، کوم چې د قرآن کريم بله نوم دی. قرآن کريم د فرقان په نامه يادېږي ځکه چې د حق او باطل تر منځ توپير کوي. دا نوم د اسلامي کلتور په تاريخ کې ډېر اهميت لري، ځکه چې د قرآن کريم يادونه کوي کوم چې د مسلمانانو لپاره روحاني لارښود دی.

in_english.name: Furqaniyah
in_english.meaning: Furqaniyah means the one who distinguishes between right and wrong
in_english.long_meaning: The name Furqaniyah originates from the Arabic term 'Furqan', which refers to the Quran, the holy book of Islam. It signifies the distinction between truth and falsehood, guiding individuals towards the right path. This name holds significant spiritual and cultural importance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing wisdom, discernment, and adherence to divine guidance. It is associated with positive personality traits such as righteousness, integrity, and moral clarity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Furqaniyah has significant cultural importance as it resonates with the idea of wisdom and knowledge acquisition, which is highly valued in Islamic society. Islam encourages individuals to seek knowledge, understand the world around them, and make informed decisions. The name embodies this principle and can serve as a source of inspiration for individuals to strive for excellence and for communities to uphold the value of wisdom and knowledge.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Furqaniyah represents a person who is guided by Allah and has the ability to distinguish between the truth and falsehood. It is a reminder of the importance of spiritual discernment and guidance, as individuals navigate the complexities of life. The name invokes a sense of inner wisdom, rooted in the lived experiences of individuals, and a deep inner conviction, drawing from the teachings of Islam. Ultimately, Furqaniyah highlights the importance of spiritual growth and the role that wisdom and knowledge play in the realization of one's inner potential and connection to the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Furqaniyah signifies one who distinguishes between right and wrong, possessing a keen discernment and wisdom in religious matters. It embodies the ideal of a guided soul, skillfully navigating the spiritual landscape.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Furqan is the name of the 28th surah of the Quran, which contains 78 verses. The name Furqaniyah carried significant weight in that era.

trends: Al-Furqan is a popular name for mosques, schools, and other Islamic institutions.
It is also the name of several Islamic organizations and publications.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Furqaniyah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
